roleTitle: Staff Development Coordinator & Infection Control Nurse (RN)
description:
Join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD, as a Staff Development Coordinator & Infection Control Nurse. This vital role combines your passion for education with your expertise in infection prevention, ensuring the highest standards of care and staff competency within our facility. You will play a key role in shaping our clinical team's skills and safeguarding our residents' health.

In this dynamic position, you will be responsible for developing and implementing comprehensive staff education programs, conducting competency assessments, and leading our infection control initiatives. Your work will directly contribute to a safe and compliant environment, fostering continuous improvement and professional growth among our dedicated healthcare professionals. We are seeking a proactive and knowledgeable RN to make a significant impact.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Proven experience in staff development and education
Demonstrated experience in infection prevention and control
Strong knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $40.00 - $42.00, compensation based on experience.
